title: Swiss rail and Zürich gain connected infrastructure accounts
summary: Gotthard, Ceneri and Zürich municipality gain distinct accounts of rail operation, recovery, connecting infrastructure and city services. Eligibility reaches 77 projects and 44 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Fifteen official HTML records inspected November 22. German and Italian interpretation is traceable. Investigation-PDF and project-page retrieval limits are explicit; accessible operator accounts do not become direct inspection of underlying instruments.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
